privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: All tools run locally in your browser. We do not upload or store your JSON data. We use Google AdSense to display ads; Google may use cookies. Contact: cirirude15@gmail.com

about.title: About Us
about.p1: We provide free online developer tools focused on local processing and privacy. All tools run locally in your browser; your data is never uploaded.
about.p2: Maintained by independent developers, we aim to offer lightweight, fast, no-registration tools for everyday use, covering JSON formatting, encoding conversion, text processing and more.
about.p3: We use Google AdSense to sustain the site. Google may use cookies to deliver personalized ads. You can manage or disable cookies in your browser settings.
about.p4: For suggestions or collaboration, contact: cirirude15@gmail.com

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.p1: For questions, feedback or business inquiries, feel free to reach us and we will reply soon.
contact.privacyNote: Privacy: All tools run locally, no upload. We use Google AdSense; Google may use cookies. Manage cookie preferences in your browser.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to our online tools. By using this site you agree to the following terms.
terms.p1: 1. Service: Free online tools run locally in your browser, without 100% availability guarantee and without storing user data.
terms.p2: 2. User conduct: Do not abuse the service or attempt to attack or disrupt the site.
terms.p3: 3. Disclaimer: Tool outputs are for reference only; we are not liable for any direct or indirect loss from using the service.
terms.p4: 4. Ads & Cookies: We use Google AdSense; Google may use cookies to deliver and measure ads. Manage via browser settings or Google Ad Settings.
terms.p5: 5. Contact: For questions about these terms, contact cirirude15@gmail.com.
